# Chengguang — Brand Assets

> Static media/asset repository for Chengguang Power Tech (Jinzhou Chengguang Power Source Co., Ltd.), a car and truck battery OEM manufacturer. Contains the company logo and product photography. This repository is not a standalone website — it stores brand assets referenced by the Chengguang Power Tech sites.

## Contents

- [Logo](https://github.com/martinxionbiotech-max/Chengguang/tree/main/logo): Chengguang logo assets.
- [Product Pictures](https://github.com/martinxionbiotech-max/Chengguang/tree/main/product%20pictures): Battery product photography (DIN/JIS/BCI series models).

## Primary site

- [Chengguang Power Tech](https://chengguangenergy.com/): Corporate/OEM marketing site.

## Notes

- No dedicated domain or website is configured in this repository; it is an asset store, so this llms.txt documents the repository rather than a served site.
